description: Use this when the user asks about one team's game on a date, its next or last game, or a specific meeting ('Lakers next game', 'Cowboys vs Eagles on November 23') and you need its game_id. Returns the team's game on that date, or its last three finished and next three games, with game_id, start time, state, week (NFL), each side's team (id and abbreviation) and score, and the pair's matchup page; each game's page is `game_url` with its id in place of {id}. Not for the whole slate (tonight_slate) or the history of a pair (head_to_head).

date.description: Optional US Eastern game day, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2026-11-23"). Omit for the last three and next three games.

opponent_id.description: Optional numeric team ID of the opponent, from search: only the games between the two.

name: find_game
title: Find a Team’s Game
